heading: Previous laws unaffected
lead: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as modifying or revoking any of the provisions of sections 191 to 193 1 of this title.

notes.text: References in TextSections 191 to 193 of this title, referred to in text, were repealed by Pub. L. 91–513, title III, § 1101(a)(1), Oct. 27, 1970, 84 Stat. 1291. See section 801 et seq. of this title.
